tagline: 宾得便携相机，1994 年发布
description: 宾得于1994年推出的便携相机。配备Pentax 32mm, f/3.5, 3 elements in 3 groups.。快门速度Programmed AE electric shutter with speed aprox. 1/400s -2 sec. Bulb: 1/2 sec. - 5 min, Electromagnetic release.。使用Auto film speed setting with 35mm perforated DX-decoding film with ISO rating from 25 to 3200. Non-DX coded films are automatically set to ISO25.。Pentax phase-matching autofocus system with focus lock.。

specs.对焦: Pentax phase-matching autofocus system with focus lock.

specs.胶片/画幅: Auto film speed setting with 35mm perforated DX-decoding film with ISO rating from 25 to 3200. Non-DX coded films are automatically set to ISO25.
